content: GitHub Copilot coding agent: triggered by issue assignment, @copilot mention on a PR, Agents panel, or third-party (Slack/Teams/Jira/Linear). Posts implementation plan, works on copilot/ branch, opens a DRAFT PR, streams session logs linked from commit messages. Limits: 59-minute max run, one branch + one PR per task, cannot work across multiple repos in one run. Safety rails: cannot push to default branch, cannot run git push directly, cannot mark PR ready/approve/merge, PR requester cannot approve it, CI workflows need human approval, no access to Actions secrets (separate Agents secrets only), egress firewall allowlist, hidden-character filtering vs prompt injection, CodeQL + secret scanning on output. Config: AGENTS.md, copilot-setup-steps.yml, MCP servers, hooks, skills.
